solution: Stripe webhook worker connection pool was exhausted; increased pool size from 10 to 50 in payment config and restarted celery-worker

qdrant_points.title: Resolving Stripe Webhook Worker Connection Pool Exhaustion
qdrant_points.chunk_text:
The Stripe webhook worker connection pool was exhausted.  
1. Increase pool size from 10 to 50 in payment config.
2. Restart celery-worker.
